precos.title: Community prices
precos.subtitle: Compare values from future purchases and follow price trends.

intro.text: In the future, the system may collect prices registered by users themselves and show aggregated comparisons. For now, this is a visual preparation of the feature.

markets.desc: In the future it may consider market and approximate region, without exposing personal data.

community.desc: User records may enrich the database collectively, respecting privacy.

mock.disclaimer: Illustrative example — the community database is not active yet.

howItWorks.title: How it may work
howItWorks.step1: The user registers a purchase as usual.
howItWorks.step2: The system identifies product, price, market and date.
howItWorks.step3: Data is handled securely and anonymized.
howItWorks.step4: The community base shows trends and future comparisons.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.point1: The feature must not expose personal data.
privacy.point2: It must not show who made the purchase.
privacy.point3: It must not show exact address.
privacy.point4: In the future it may use only aggregated and approximate data.
privacy.point5: The user will have control over participation when this feature is implemented.
privacy.futureOptIn: When the community base is ready, the user will decide whether to participate. No data will be shared without consent.
